name: Prospect People and Add to Sequence
description: End-to-end outbound workflow: search for people matching your ICP, create them as contacts in Apollo, and add them to an outreach sequence. Handles the full prospect -> contact -> sequence pipeline.

personTitles.description: Job titles to search for. Examples: ['VP of Engineering', 'CTO']

personSeniorities.description: Seniority levels. Allowed: owner, founder, c_suite, partner, vp, head, director, manager, senior, entry, intern

maxContacts.description: Maximum number of people to prospect and add (1-100)

sequenceId.description: Apollo sequence (emailer campaign) ID to add contacts to

emailAccountId.description: Apollo email account ID to send emails from

steps.name: Create Apollo contacts from search results
Add contacts to the outreach sequence
